the Roanoke City and Alleghany Health Districts (RCAHD) in southwestern Virginia investigated an outbreak of hepatitis A.
As of September 30, 2022,* an additional 98 cases had been reported to RCAHD.
Public health officials conducted a comprehensive medical record review of all cases to identify patient risk factors, contacts, and exposures.
